description: Allow accounts to send you private messages. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

allow.description: List of Geode account addresses (SS58), at most 50

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_messaging_allow_account
title: Messaging: allow account
